{{Aquarius}}
Aquarius 21 is the 77th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 21st day of Aquarius, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 11, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 3宮21日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 77|Chapter 77]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152097}}.
